The image displays soybean leaves with distinct symptoms. The leaves are yellowish-green and exhibit numerous angular, reddish-brown spots. Some of these spots have coalesced into larger necrotic patches. This pattern of small, angular, reddish-brown lesions on yellowing leaves is characteristic of Septoria Brown Spot.
